hypotheses.P1_128x64_useful_frontier: Hybrid-128/output-64 has median native KL at most 0.04 and at least 10x counted dense-multiply reduction on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_128x128_higher_fidelity: Hybrid-128/output-128 has median native KL at most 0.035 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_256x64_strong_fidelity: Hybrid-256/output-64 has median native KL at most 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_monotone_input_width: At fixed output rank, increasing input dimension never increases median native KL on any corpus.
hypotheses.P5_monotone_output_rank: At fixed input dimension, increasing output rank never increases median native KL on any corpus.
